name: Vertical Blinds Collection
description: Vertical Blinds offer a versatile and practical solution for large windows and sliding doors, with a wide selection of materials, textures, and colors.

benefits.text:
27
 Three Product Collections
 Hunter Douglas Vertical Blinds feature three distinct collections; Cadence®, 
Somner®, and Vertical Solutions®.
 Control the Light and Maximize the View
Vertical Blinds provide minimal stack when open, with vane tilt options to      
customize the light in any room while maximizing the view.
 Superior Functionality
Three proprietary operating systems provide smooth functionality  
guaranteed to last a lifetime.
Contemporary Style
Fashion-forward styles featuring on-trend hues, rich textures, and patterns 
in fabric, vinyl, and aluminum.
26
 Modern Aesthetic
The clean lines of Vertical Blinds provide a modern aesthetic covering
expansive windows using a single headrail.
Benefits
